buyer.name: random
buyer.description: Uniform random price in [production_cost, market_price].

buyer.name: budget
buyer.description: Uniform random price in [0.5*cost, 0.8*market]; cash-constrained buyer.

buyer.name: wild
buyer.description: Uniform random in [0, 1.2*market_price] — highly inconsistent.

buyer.name: concession
buyer.description: Linear concession from start_frac=0.10 to end_frac=0.60 of [cost, market].

buyer.name: anchor_drag
buyer.description: Anchors 5% above cost; upward step of 3% of [cost,market] per round.

buyer.name: boulware_buyer
buyer.description: Convex concession curve (exponent=4); most concession concentrated late in the trajectory.

buyer.name: conceder_buyer
buyer.description: Concave concession curve (exponent=0.35); most concession concentrated early in the trajectory.

buyer.name: tit_for_tat_buyer
buyer.description: Mirrors the seller's last concession: if the seller drops by $X, the buyer raises by 0.7*$X.  Anchors at 10% of [cost,market] in round 1.

buyer.name: persistent_f0.30
buyer.description: Fixed target at 30% of market_price (±$0.02 noise).

buyer.name: persistent_f0.55
buyer.description: Fixed target at 55% of market_price (±$0.02 noise).
